newsitem.title: USA: Children's Broadcasting completes loan pact.
newsitem.headline: Children's Broadcasting completes loan pact.

text.p: Children's Broadcasting Corp (CBC) said Wednesday it completed a $16.5-million credit facility with Foothill Capital Corp secured by Children's Broadcasting's assets.

The loan will give the company the cash it needs to buy more radio stations so it can expand distribution of its Radio AAHS program, the company said. The company also recently reestablished an in-house marketing and sales effort.
Children's Broadcasting produces radio programming for children aged 12 and younger that is broadcast via satellite to 40 percent of the nation.
